svg.text: Attention Stories: When SQL Listens to Natural Language
Cross-attention matrix A = softmax(H_s · H_q^T / √768) reveals SQL-NL semantic alignment
SQL correctly captures user intent → concentrated attention
SQL uses MAX instead of AVG → scattered attention
NL: "What is the average age per department?"
